forum.title: How to implement ADC4
forum.content_text:
I set PA6 and PA7 to ADC4\_INx in CubeMX and ran CODE GENERATE.

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/1f3c4d02-0d0b-4259-9ad0-a21bb9882ae2.png)

The generated main.c file implements MX\_ADC4\_Init(), but it doesn't seem to be called from anywhere.

Should I call this somewhere in the main statement?

Also, I tried implementing ADC reading within the main loop, but the return value of HAL\_ADC\_GetValue() is always 0 (even though it's actually around VDD/2).

I've attached main.c. Could you please tell me the correct implementation method?
forum.author: gocchan
